description: Create SmcFvgBot.cs at repo root: a cTrader Automate (cAlgo) C# cBot that reimplements the SMC-FVG STRATEGY logic from smc_fvg_strategy.pine. Port the market-structure state machine, FVG-within-break detection, Internal/Swing/Both trade gate, Limit/Market entry with fib level, SL in pips, TP Points/RRR modes, concurrent-order cap, indefinite pending orders, and a DrawStaticText stats dashboard. DROP all trade-projection chart drawing (explicit user instruction 'dont add projection'). Cannot be compiled here (no cAlgo assemblies); prioritize API-correct idiomatic cAlgo code and faithful logic parity.
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/tradingviewbridge/SmcFvgBot.cs. Use `using cAlgo.API;` and `using cAlgo.API.Internals;` (and System/System.Linq). Declare a public class SmcFvgBot : Robot decorated with [Robot(AccessRights = AccessRights.None, TimeZone = TimeZones.UTC)] (or a sensible default). Document the indexing convention in a header comment: OnBar fires at the open of a new bar so the just-closed confirmed bar is Bars.*.Last(1); Pine high[size] maps to Bars.*.Last(size). Match Pine 'confirmed on close' by evaluating structure on the just-closed bar.

Add [Parameter] properties matching the Pine inputs, with the PIPS unit change flagged in comments: SwingLength (int, DefaultValue 50, MinValue 10, Group 'Structure'); keep internal structure size fixed at 5 (const, note the choice in a comment). FvgSource enum {Internal, Swing, Both} DefaultValue Internal, Group 'Structure'. EntryMode enum {Limit, Market} DefaultValue Limit; EntryFib enum with values mapping to {0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1} (default 0) - implement as an enum whose selection maps to the numeric fib, Group 'Entry'. StopLossPips (double, DefaultValue 30, MinValue 0, Group 'Risk' - NOTE Pine default was 300 in raw price units; unit is now PIPS so numeric default changes; flag in comment). TpMode enum {Points, RRR} DefaultValue Points; TakeProfitPips (double, DefaultValue 500, MinValue 0 - NOTE Pine default was 5000 raw points; unit now PIPS; flag). Rrr (double, DefaultValue 3, MinValue 0). Sizing: expose a Quantity in lots (double, DefaultValue 1) and convert with Symbol.QuantityToVolumeInUnits(Quantity) normalized via Symbol.NormalizeVolumeInUnits; note the choice in a comment. MaxConcurrentOrders (int, DefaultValue 100, MinValue 1, Group 'Risk'). ShowDashboard (bool, DefaultValue true, Group 'Dashboard').

Port the market-structure state machine as persistent FIELDS (not locals): pivot structs/classes for swingHigh, swingLow, internalHigh, internalLow each with currentLevel, lastLevel, crossed, barIndex; int swingTrendBias and internalTrendBias (BULLISH=+1, BEARISH=-1, 0=none). Implement leg(size): newLegHigh = high(size back) > highest over the size window; newLegLow = low(size back) < lowest over the window; leg persists (var leg field per size - use two separate persisted leg fields, one for swing size and one for internal size 5). startOfNewLeg via change of leg value between bars (persist previous leg value). Implement getCurrentStructure(size, internal) updating the correct pivot on a new bullish/bearish leg (pivotLow -> update low pivot with low[size]; pivotHigh -> update high pivot with high[size]; set barIndex = current index - size).

Port displayStructure(internal): using the just-closed bar, detect bullish break = crossover(close, pivotHigh.currentLevel) && !pivotHigh.crossed (crossover: close two bars before <= level && just-closed close > level). On bullish break: tag = (trendBias == BEARISH ? CHoCH : BOS), set pivotHigh.crossed = true, trendBias = BULLISH; if the FvgSource gate enables this structure type (Internal gate for internal breaks, Swing gate for swing breaks, Both enables either) then scan for the last bullish FVG in the leg and place ONE long order. Symmetric for bearish break = crossunder(close, pivotLow.currentLevel): tag CHoCH/BOS, pivotLow.crossed=true, trendBias=BEARISH, gate, last bearish FVG, ONE short order. The FvgSource enum is the SINGLE source of truth for enabling trades per structure type. Call getCurrentStructure(SwingLength,false) and getCurrentStructure(5,true) each bar, then displayStructure(true) for internal and displayStructure(false) for swing, matching Pine execution order.

Port highlightStructFvg(pivotBarIndex, isBull): span = min(currentIndex - pivotBarIndex, 300); scan k from 0 to span-2 (from break bar backwards); bullish hit = low(k back) > high(k+2 back); bearish hit = high(k back) < low(k+2 back); take the FIRST (most recent) hit. Compute FVG bounds: bull top = low[found], bottom = high[found+2]; bear top = high[found+2] (i.e. price-ordered max) - reproduce Pine exactly: t/b then top=max(t,b), bottom=min(t,b). Return whether a FVG was found and its price-ordered top/bottom so the caller places an order only when a FVG exists (Pine places exactly one order per confirmed break, for the last FVG in the leg). Indices are relative to the just-closed bar per the documented convention.

Port placeStrategyOrder(isBull, nearEdge, farEdge): guard on the cap first - count this bot's OWN live orders = PendingOrders.Count(o => o.Label != null && o.Label.StartsWith(BotLabelPrefix)) + Positions.Count(p => p.Label != null && p.Label.StartsWith(BotLabelPrefix)); if >= MaxConcurrentOrders, skip. For a long near=FVG top, far=FVG bottom; for a short near=FVG bottom, far=FVG top. fib from EntryFib enum. entry = Market ? Bars.ClosePrices.Last(1) : nearEdge + fib*(farEdge-nearEdge). Build a unique label: BotLabelPrefix + incrementing counter field. Compute volume from Quantity. Market mode: ExecuteMarketOrder(isBull?TradeType.Buy:TradeType.Sell, SymbolName, volume, label, StopLossPips, takeProfitPips). Limit mode: PlaceLimitOrder(isBull?TradeType.Buy:TradeType.Sell, SymbolName, volume, targetPrice, label, StopLossPips, takeProfitPips) with NO expiration (pending orders stay open indefinitely). takeProfitPips = TpMode==RRR ? Rrr*StopLossPips : TakeProfitPips. If unsure about an exact overload, use one you are confident exists and add a comment noting the assumption. Pass SL/TP as pips (double) directly to the order calls. Do NOT create any projection boxes/lines.

Port the dashboard as ON-CHART TEXT via Chart.DrawStaticText, updated each bar in OnBar when ShowDashboard is true. Compute stats from History filtered to the bot's OWN trades (HistoricalTrade where Label starts with BotLabelPrefix): Win Rate = winning closed / total closed * 100 (guard /0 -> 'n/a'); Total Net Pips = sum of HistoricalTrade.Pips; Max Losing Streak and Max Winning Streak = longest run of consecutive losing/winning closed trades in chronological order (profit>0 win, <0 loss, ==0 ignored - use NetProfit for win/loss classification, Pips for the net pips total); Total RRR = sum(win pips)/abs(sum(loss pips)) profit-factor style, 'n/a' when no losses. Build a single multi-line string (Win Rate, Total Net Pips, Max Losing Streak, Max Winning Streak, Total RRR) and Chart.DrawStaticText(objectName, text, VerticalAlignment.Top, HorizontalAlignment.Right, a legible color). DrawStaticText has no background fill - keep it simple. Do NOT count trades from other bots/manual trades.

Implement OnStart (initialize fields/counters), OnBar (prune not needed since cAlgo tracks orders/positions natively; run: update leg/pivot state for swing and internal, run displayStructure for internal then swing, then update dashboard), and OnStop (optional cleanup). Ensure all structure/leg/trend/counter state are fields so they persist across bars. Add clear comments mapping each block back to the Pine function it ports.
acceptance_criteria: SmcFvgBot.cs exists at repo root and is a Robot subclass with [Robot], [Parameter] attributes, and OnStart/OnBar/OnStop.
No .pine file is modified (git status shows only SmcFvgBot.cs added).
The FvgSource enum (Internal/Swing/Both) is the single gate that enables trade placement per structure type, matching the Pine bullMakeFvg/bearMakeFvg gate.

Entry supports Limit (fib-priced PlaceLimitOrder, no expiration) and Market (ExecuteMarketOrder at just-closed close, fib ignored); SL is in pips; TP supports Points (fixed pips) and RRR (Rrr*SL pips).
MaxConcurrentOrders cap counts only the bot's own pending orders + positions (by label prefix) before placing.

Dashboard uses Chart.DrawStaticText with a single multi-line string showing Win Rate, Total Net Pips, Max Losing Streak, Max Winning Streak, Total RRR, computed only from the bot's own History (by label prefix), with divide-by-zero guards.
NO trade-projection drawing (no boxes/lines for TP/SL zones or entry line) exists anywhere in the file.
SL/TP numeric defaults are changed to pip-appropriate values (e.g. 30 and 500) with in-code comments flagging that the unit changed from Pine's raw price points.
verification: Static self-review: read SmcFvgBot.cs end-to-end and confirm cAlgo API usage (Robot/Parameter attributes, ExecuteMarketOrder/PlaceLimitOrder overloads with stopLossPips/takeProfitPips, History/HistoricalTrade.Pips filtered by label, Chart.DrawStaticText signature, TradeType/Symbol usage).
Static self-review: trace the leg/pivot/trend state machine, FVG scan, source gate, entry modes, SL/TP modes, and cap against smc_fvg_strategy.pine confirming parity.
grep to confirm no projection drawing was ported: search SmcFvgBot.cs for 'DrawBox'/'DrawRectangle'/'DrawTrendLine'/projection terms and confirm none exist (dashboard DrawStaticText is allowed).
Run `git status` and confirm only SmcFvgBot.cs is added and no .pine file changed.
NOTE: dotnet build is NOT possible (cAlgo assemblies absent); do not attempt it. Final compilation happens in cTrader Automate.
findings: Created SmcFvgBot.cs at repo root: cAlgo cBot port of smc_fvg_strategy.pine. Implemented: leg/pivot/trend state machine as persistent fields (swing size = SwingLength default 50; internal size fixed const 5); leg() has two persisted call sites (swing + internal) each with previous-value tracking to reproduce ta.change(leg); getCurrentStructure updates low pivot on new bullish leg / high pivot on new bearish leg with barIndex = CurrentBarIndex - size; displayStructure detects crossover/crossunder at the just-closed bar. Indexing convention documented in header: OnBar fires at open of new bar so just-closed bar = Last(1); Pine [k] maps to Last(k+1) via H/L/C/O helpers, so index k reads exactly like Pine [k]. Crossover = C(1)<=level && C(0)>level; Crossunder = C(1)>=level && C(0)<level. FVG scan HighlightStructFvg: span=min(CurrentBarIndex-pivotBar,300), first (most recent) hit for k=0..span-2 (bull low[k]>high[k+2]; bear high[k]<low[k+2]); price-ordered top/bottom; returns Found so caller places exactly ONE order per confirmed break. FvgSource enum {Internal,Swing,Both} is the single gate (FvgGateEnabled) matching Pine bullMakeFvg/bearMakeFvg. placeStrategyOrder: cap guard counts bot's OWN PendingOrders+Positions by label prefix 'SmcFvg_' before placing; unique label = prefix + incrementing counter; Market => ExecuteMarketOrder at just-closed close (fib ignored); Limit => PlaceLimitOrder at nearEdge+fib*(farEdge-nearEdge) rounded to Symbol.Digits, NO expiration; long near=FVG top/far=FVG bottom, short near=FVG bottom/far=FVG top. SL in PIPS (default 30, was 300 raw in Pine - flagged in comment); TP Points=TakeProfitPips (default 500, was 5000 raw - flagged) or RRR=Rrr*StopLossPips. Sizing via Symbol.QuantityToVolumeInUnits(Quantity) normalized (RoundingMode.Down). Dashboard via Chart.DrawStaticText single multi-line string top-right (Color.White), stats in pips from History filtered by label prefix: Win Rate (winning/total*100, n/a on /0), Total Net Pips (sum HistoricalTrade.Pips), Max Losing/Winning Streak (chronological runs by NetProfit sign, ==0 ignored), Total RRR (sum win pips/abs sum loss pips, n/a when no losses). DROPPED all trade-projection drawing (TP/SL zone boxes, entry line) and all structure/FVG/label drawing per user 'dont add projection'; only DrawStaticText remains. NOTE: C# reserved keyword 'internal' could not be used as a parameter name, so the isInternal parameter name is used throughout (Leg/GetCurrentStructure/DisplayStructure/FvgGateEnabled). API OVERLOAD ASSUMPTIONS (could not compile - cAlgo assemblies absent in sandbox): assumed ExecuteMarketOrder(TradeType, symbolName, volume, label, stopLossPips, takeProfitPips) and PlaceLimitOrder(TradeType, symbolName, volume, targetPrice, label, stopLossPips, takeProfitPips) exist in current cAlgo API (noted inline). Also assumed HistoricalTrade exposes .Label, .Pips, .NetProfit; Symbol.QuantityToVolumeInUnits / NormalizeVolumeInUnits(RoundingMode.Down); Chart.DrawStaticText(name, text, VerticalAlignment, HorizontalAlignment, Color). User must confirm/compile in cTrader Automate. Verified: no .pine files modified; grep confirms no DrawBox/DrawRectangle/DrawTrendLine/box/line projection drawing; only SmcFvgBot.cs added. REVIEW ROUND 2 (2026-09-11-210947-review.md) changes: (#1 FIXED) Restored Pine's internal-only extraCondition gate in DisplayStructure - added bullExtraCondition/bearExtraCondition = !isInternal || (!IsNaN(swing.CurrentLevel) && internal.CurrentLevel != swing.CurrentLevel), ANDed into BOTH the bullish (crossover) and bearish (crossunder) internal-branch guards so it suppresses the crossed flip, trend flip, FVG scan and order (matching Pine lines 485/488 and 516/519 where extraCondition gates the whole break block). Swing branches keep extraCondition=true (the !isInternal short-circuit). The bullishBar/bearishBar confluence terms remain dropped (confluence input not ported, defaults true). Also reproduced Pine's `a != na`->falsy semantics: when the swing pivot level is NaN (unset) the internal gate is falsy and suppresses, since C# NaN!=x is true and would otherwise diverge. This was a real logic-parity bug on the DEFAULT trade path (FvgApplyTo defaults to Internal). (#4 GUARDED) StopLossPips/TakeProfitPips of 0 (or negative) are now mapped to null (double?) before the order calls instead of forwarded as a real 0-pip distance, since in cAlgo 0 distance != 'no stop'; this matches Pine's minval-0 'off' intent. (#2 and #3 DOCUMENTED, intentionally NOT reverted per orchestrator's PIPS+History requirement) Added an explicit comment block on UpdateDashboard confirming: Total Net Pips uses sum(HistoricalTrade.Pips) rather than Pine's raw-price Total Points (deliberate unit change to broker-normalized pips via cAlgo History); and win/loss sign for streaks and Win Rate is keyed off HistoricalTrade.NetProfit (money, matching Pine closedtrades.profit basis) while pip magnitudes use HistoricalTrade.Pips - the NetProfit-for-sign / Pips-for-magnitude split is intentional, not a bug. API overloads previously flagged were confirmed correct by the reviewer against the current cAlgo API; no API changes made. Still cannot compile in sandbox (cAlgo assemblies absent) - changes verified by static reasoning only.
